newsitem.title: UK: NatWest sets 300 bln lire ENI-linked notes.
newsitem.headline: NatWest sets 300 bln lire ENI-linked notes.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc has launched a 300 billion lire three-year notes issue whose redemption value is linked to ENI SpA's share price, NatWest Securities said.

Investors, who will be repaid at par at maturity, may also receive a further payment linked to out-performance of ordinary shares of ENI over the Italian MIB-30 stock index over the life of the issue.

NatWest said ENI accounted for around 22 percent of the MIB-30 index. ENI has outperformed the MIB-30 by around 40 percent over the past 12 months, NatWest said. The initial price of the issue is 97-98 percent of face value. The London-listed notes will not carry any coupons.
